mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1150 and RSAFS > 470000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong industrial production index (above 105.5) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial expansion (INDPRO above 105.0), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1150 and RSAFS > 470000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
